findings.description: The new TTS_ENABLED and TTS_LANGUAGE settings added to config.py are not reflected in .env.example, so operators deploying fresh instances won't know these options exist.

findings.issue: No rate limiting on TTS endpoint
findings.description: The /tts/speak endpoint generates audio via an external Google service on each request. Without rate limiting, a misbehaving client or accidental loop could exhaust API quotas or incur unexpected costs.
findings.action: Add rate limiting to the TTS endpoint or document the quota implications

findings.description: The TTSSpeaker component exists but is not wired into any screen. The feature will not be visible to users until a parent component renders TTSSpeaker with recommendation text.
findings.action: Integrate TTSSpeaker into OutfitRecommendationsScreen or another appropriate parent component
